hook.es: Los símbolos estaban ahí desde el principio.
hook.en: The symbols were there from the beginning.

objective: NØVA notices the recurring geometric symbols across every world visited so far (code, circuits, water, stars, architecture) and begins assembling them. The first four fragments of the cipher are revealed in sequence, building toward the finale.

scenes.visuals: NØVA flying past the luminous ruins (Ep03), Peskids' water symbols (Ep06), Moon's globe glyphs (Ep08) — pausing at each, recognizing the same geometry
scenes.copy: NØVA notó algo. Los mismos símbolos, en todos los mundos.
assets_needed: symbol-recognition montage across prior episode environments

scenes.visuals: NØVA arranges glowing fragments into the first line of text
A second fragment assembles near one of the luminous ruins from Episode 3
A third fragment assembles near the layered Opsly structure
scenes.copy: WHAT YOU BUILD ALSO BUILDS YOU.

scenes.visuals: A fourth fragment assembles near Moon's globe
scenes.copy: THE MAP DOES NOT EXIST UNTIL YOU WALK IT.

scenes.visuals: NØVA and The Traveler looking at the four assembled fragments, a fifth space clearly still empty
scenes.copy: Cuatro fragmentos. Uno más para completar el mensaje.
